rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);

SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');


#DROP TABLE IF EXISTS s_opd_all;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_opd_all(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  target int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result10 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result11 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result12 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result01 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result02 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result03 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result04 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result05 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result06 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result07 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result08 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  result09 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_opd_all WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_opd_all 
(
	SELECT 
		 @id,s.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode	
		,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))

		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1001') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1031')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1101') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1131')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1201') AND CONCAT(@b_year-1,'1231')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0101') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0131')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0201') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0231')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0301') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0331')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0401') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0431')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0501') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0531')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0601') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0631')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0701') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0731')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0801') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0831')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))
		,COUNT(DISTINCT if(s.date_serv BETWEEN CONCAT(@b_year,'0901') AND CONCAT(@b_year,'0931')
										,CONCAT(s.hospcode,'-',s.pid,'-',s.seq),NULL))

	FROM
		tmp_service s,chospital h
	WHERE
		s.hospcode=h.hoscode
		AND s.date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
		AND h.provcode = @prov_c
	GROUP BY
	s.hospcode,areacode
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, sum("target") as "target" , sum("result") as "result"   , ROUND((sum("result")/NULLIF(sum("target"),0)),2) as "p"   ,sum("result10") as "m10",sum("result11") as "m11",sum("result12") as "m12" ,sum("result01") as "m01",sum("result02") as "m02",sum("result03") as "m03"   ,sum("result04") as "m04",sum("result05") as "m05",sum("result06") as "m06" ,sum("result07") as "m07",sum("result08") as "m08",sum("result09") as "m09"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.query: SELECT c.splevel as a_code ,c.splevel as a_name , sum("target") as "target" , sum("result") as "result"   , ROUND((sum("result")/NULLIF(sum("target"),0)),2) as "p"   ,sum("result10") as "m10",sum("result11") as "m11",sum("result12") as "m12" ,sum("result01") as "m01",sum("result02") as "m02",sum("result03") as "m03"   ,sum("result04") as "m04",sum("result05") as "m05",sum("result06") as "m06" ,sum("result07") as "m07",sum("result08") as "m08",sum("result09") as "m09"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp as c ON h.hoscode = c.hcode LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( c.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY c.splevel
